text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the break, I decided to go up to the rooftop
for some fresh air. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing there in her racing silks was Zenno Rob Roy,
striking a majestic pose with an imposing expression.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if it's okay to call out to her...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching their passionate display,
I pondered what we ought to do, when—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Wait, whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa...!!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!? D-D-Did you just...
happen to see that... !?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
~~...!! Th-The pleasure is mine...
I-I'm so sorry you had to see me in such an embarrassing state...gh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy was in a complete fluster.
After a little while, once she had calmed down,
I decided to listen to what she had to say.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, in order to become like Rob Roy, I thought I'd start by looking the part, so I've been practicing...
choice_data_list: So that's what was going on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I nodded, a thought crossed my mind.
Come to think of it, of all the heroes out there,
why was it Rob Roy she looked up to so much?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I voiced my question,
Zenno Rob Roy replied like this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's—because Rob Roy became a hero
throughout the course of the story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Most heroes possessed unmistakable qualities, destined to become heroes as they were meant to be.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Like the hero who pulled the sword from the stone,
or the hero who overcame the twelve trials.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
However... Rob Roy was different.
He was born an ordinary person,
and as an ordinary person, he stood against power.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Novels written about them by later authors turned their deeds into legend,
and they came to be recognized as heroes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So I thought, maybe I should too...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I still do not know.
Whether I have the qualities of a hero or not.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yet with stories by my side, I can become like Rob Roy—
yes, that is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I poured that wish into my racing outfit.
So that I could become a hero of a story, just like him—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I incorporated the traditional attire of Scotland, the land where he made his mark, into the design.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her respect for Rob Roy
made me feel like I understood her perspective on heroes a bit deeper. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*applause* *clap clap clap clap!*)

Lured by the recitativo of the little birds,
I arrive only to be treated to the aria of a hero!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Splendid! That's a wonderful spirit, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To you, this story must surely resemble
a song composed to adorn this Overlord, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "In that case, pursue your story! For it is beyond that narrative that your royal road surely lies!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hearing that from you, Opera O-san, someone who constantly strives to embody the Overlord, makes me feel like I can believe in myself even more...!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of hero you become.
Alright, let's keep up the practice just like this!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mm. No matter what fierce rivals appear ahead, the path you walk belongs to you alone.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Reach out for any crown your heart desires.
Do so, and you shall surely become the hero you wish to be.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Reaching for any crown as you desire—...
Yes, that is exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I will claim my own crown, the name of hero!
No matter who I must compete against ahead—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing T.M. Opera O's words,
Zenno Rob Roy found a renewed sense of determination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that if she wanted to dress the part, she should start mastering the demeanor and conduct of a hero step by step.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho! Then it's my time to shine!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
All right, Rob Roy-kun!
Allow this Supreme Ruler to give you a lesson!
Follow my lead and strike a pose!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, yes?!
U-Understood!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Follow the overture of your heart!!
Play your harmony more and more!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though looking shy,
Zenno Rob Roy strikes a dignified pose.
Her expression seemed somehow refreshed.
